rows.en: ＊Sakaki＊＠１３０＿０１２Good work today. You were really￥giving it your all.
＊Sakaki＊＠１３０＿０１４Don't let the stress pile up.￥Taking care of yourself￥matters too.
＊Kaname＊＠１３０＿０１９Come to think of it,￥we had this same conversation￥during that blackout, didn't we?
＊Kaname＊＠１３０＿０２０Speaking of blackouts,￥the control system here￥sure glitches a lot.
＊Kaname＊＠１３０＿０２１So the supervisors have it￥really rough.＝＠１３０＿０２２Yuri especially. She's so busy,￥yet she does twice the work of￥anyone else!
＊Kaname＊＠１３０＿０２４Someday, I want to be￥a real grown-up woman￥just like Yuri!
＊Kaname＊＠１３０＿０２５Yeah. I want to be like her.
＊Kaname＊＠１３０＿０２６And someday, I want to be￥a real grown-up woman￥just like Yuri!
＊Kaname＊＠１３１＿００２It's almost time to eat, so I￥came to get you, Cousin.
＊Kaname＊＠１３１＿００４Great!￥I worked hard in training today,￥so I'm starving.＝＠１３１＿００５Come on! Let's hurry!!
＊Kaname＊＠１３１＿００６Aww! Quit playing hard to get!!＝＠１３１＿００７I'm starving, so￥let's hurry up and go!!
＊Riko＊＠１３１＿００８Oh! Kaname, Kaname!!＝＠１３１＿００９I heard it from Narusawa!＝＠１３１＿０１０You pulled off some insane￥training in no time at all!＝＠１３１＿０１１Narusawa was praising you!￥He said you've got guts!
＊Kaname＊＠１３１＿０１２Whoa! Really?!￥That makes me so happy.＝＠１３１＿０１３So the harder you work, the more￥it pays off.＝＠１３１＿０１４Thanks for telling me, Riko!
＊Riko＊＠１３１＿０１６Good for you, Kaname!＝＠１３１＿０１７Well, I already finished￥eating, so I'm heading out.￥See ya.
＊Kaname＊＠１３１＿０１９Thank you.＝＠１３１＿０２０Hearing that from you, Cousin,￥makes me happiest of all.
＊Kaname＊＠１３１＿０２２But I'm really happy.＝＠１３１＿０２３I thought,￥"I can't keep going like this,"￥so...＝＠１３１＿０２４I've been training seriously.
＊Kaname＊＠１３１＿０２６But I realized that's no good.＝＠１３１＿０２７I have to work hard so you'll￥choose me as your partner￥for who I am.
＊Kaname＊＠１３１＿０２９But even after saying that,￥I bet you'll end up picking￥someone else, Cousin!!
＊Kaname＊＠１３１＿０３１There's not much time left￥before the exams end, but...
＊Kaname＊＠１３１＿０３２I'll work my hardest, so that￥I can be the one who names you￥as my partner!
